gaps.explanation: Pass 8 (re-trim, user ruling 2026-11-18: make Lincoln FY2022 like FY2023-25). Read trimmed pp15-16 (Subcombining Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Nonmajor Special Revenue Funds, printed pp110-111; p16 is the right half, rows aligned by position with p15's labels: Real Property and Personal Property Tax, Wheel Tax, Sundry and In Lieu Tax, Special Assessment, Intergovernmental, Permits and Fees, Reimbursement for Services, Investment Earnings (Loss), Donations, Keno Proceeds, Private Sector Share of Projects, Miscellaneous), p17 (Nonmajor Debt Service Funds, printed p115), p18 (Nonmajor Capital Projects Funds, printed p119), p19 (Nonmajor Permanent Funds, printed p123). One line per printed non-zero cell per individual fund column (never the Total column, never subtotal rows), schedule names as Lincoln_FY2023 ('Combining Statement - Nonmajor ... Funds'), fund names as FY2023/FY2024 spell them (Special Assessment columns: 'Special Assessment Special Revenue Fund', 'Special Assessment Debt Service Fund', 'Special Assessment Capital Projects Fund'). Labels as printed (user_rules.py applies the standard renames). Self-check against the printed Total column, revenues: special revenue 72,130,575 (sum of the 16 fund columns = 72,130,575; each row also re-adds, e.g. Permits and Fees 192,441 + 162,207 + 4,971,201 + 2,246,961 + 8,655,809 + 189,235 = 16,417,854; Investment Earnings (Loss) net (313,779)); debt service 3,431,604 + 3,996,289 + 2,331,054 + 1,526,082 = 11,285,029; capital projects 16,718,268 + 9,764,846 + 373,706 + 4,844,795 = 31,701,615; permanent (10,392,115) + (93,180) = (10,485,295). All four tie exactly. Added revenue 104,631,924. Removed: the 43 revenue lines of the 13 'Budget and Actual (Budget Basis)' nonmajor schedules (detail indices 60-166, source pp24-36; Cable Access Television, Lincoln City Libraries, Lincoln/Lancaster County Health, Social Security, StarTran, Keno, Building & Safety, Library Special Trust, Lincoln Bike Share, Tax Allocation Projects, Bond Interest & Redemption, Tax Supported Bonds, Community Health Permanent Endowment): they are budget-basis figures for the same funds' money, which is now carried by the statement-basis lines from pp15-19 (keeping both would count it twice). The 60 governmental funds statement lines (p4, major funds General, Street Construction, West Haymarket JPA, Federal Grants; indices 0-59) are untouched. Note: detail_totals still holds the budget-basis totals of the removed schedules (source pp24-36); the fix format has no detail_totals field, so they are not changed here.
